status.text:
ok here it is - my first Opus 5.5 vibecoded threejs 3D experience

my God!! Opus is creative!!

I made a road that forgets which way is down.

It folds 90° up a yellow wall, runs upside down across a ceiling, and turns into sheet music: steer through the notes to play each street's melody.

Watercolour. Ink. A radio on the roof.

#vibejam
